profile.headline: Co-Founder Cortex Labs
profile.summary: I love connecting with new people, uncovering their challenges and helping find solutions. Every day I try to make life a little simpler for my clients using my skills in technology.

positions.title: Digital Marketing/Email Marketing
positions.description:
As Email Marketing manager, I was the lead for all digital email-marketing campaigns for Bacardi Global Brands, including Bacardi Rum, Grey Goose Vodka, Bombay Sapphire Gin, and Dewar's Scotch Whisky. Email campaigns spanned North America and Europe. Responsibilities included:

• CRM management
• LDA Data compliance
• CAN-SPAM, CASL, and CNSA compliance 
• Analytics and performance
• E-mail UX
• ESP management and integration
